An old heart stays young in loving wealth and long life; given two valleys of riches, man wants a third, only dust fills him, and Allah turns to the repentant.
The Prophet said those good before Islam are good in Islam if they understand it, the best shun authority until it is thrust on them, and the worst are double-faced.
The Prophet said people are like a hundred camels, among which not even one is found fit for riding.
Every child is born on the fitra, his parents making him a Jew, Christian or Magian; asked about those dying young, the Prophet said Allah knows what they would do.
